title: Chemical Bonding
description: Atoms share electrons because a shared wavefunction has lower energy. Unlocks the Chemical Reactor.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the bond order of the O2 molecule from its molecular-orbital electron counts.

title: Quantum Foundations
description: Everything is a wave until it is measured. Catalogue phenomena with the Spectral Analyzer to begin.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the de Broglie wavelength of an electron in nm, with h in 1e-34 J s, m in 1e-31 kg and v in 1e6 m/s (the unit factors combine to 1 nm).

title: Tachyonics
description: Hypothetical faster-than-light particles. Their imaginary mass makes them slow down as they gain energy.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the squared speed (in units of c²) of a tachyon whose imaginary-mass scale divided by its energy is r = |μ|c²/E = 0.75.

title: Formal Logic
description: Axioms, inference rules, proofs. Unlocks the Formal Proof Assistant and the Empty Set.

old_puzzle.goal: Show how many distinct Boolean functions (truth tables) exist on n propositional variables, with n = 3.

title: Molecular Biology
description: Life is chemistry that copies itself. Unlocks the Bioreactor, Nutrient Broth and the Gene Sampler.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how many DNA copies exist after g = 10 rounds of replication starting from N0 = 5 molecules.

title: Topological Matter
description: Phases of matter protected by topology rather than symmetry.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Hall conductance of a topological insulator state with Chern number ν (quantum Hall effect).

title: Chronodynamics
description: If time is quantised, its quanta can be stored.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the minimum energy uncertainty (eV) of a state that lasts Δt = 1 fs, with ħ = 0.658 eV fs.

title: High-Energy Particle Physics
description: Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the bending radius of a collider ring for protons of momentum p in dipole field B.

title: Complex Analysis
description: Add the square root of minus one and every polynomial has its roots. Fourier series and fractals follow.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the modulus of each of the n complex n-th roots of a number with modulus r.

title: Number Theory
description: Primes, modular forms and the Riemann zeta function - the hardest problems in mathematics are about whole numbers.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the approximate number of primes below one million using the prime number theorem.

title: Set Theory
description: Everything is a set. Power sets, the continuum, and the axiom of choice.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how many elements the power set of the power set of an n-element set has.

title: Temporal Mechanics
description: The arrow of time, and how to tie it in knots without causing a paradox. Unlocks the Chrono Loom.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the entropy increase when n moles of gas expand freely from V1 to V2 - the thermodynamic arrow of time.

title: Assembly Lines
description: Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the total time a k-stage pipelined assembly line needs to produce N components.

title: CPT Symmetry
description: Reverse charge, parity and time together and the laws of physics do not change. Somewhere, then, there is a universe of antimatter. Unlocks the CPT Mirror and the Penning Harness.

old_puzzle.goal: An electron and a positron annihilate into two photons; find each photon's wavelength (the Compton wavelength) in pm. h in 1e-34 J s, m in 1e-31 kg, c in 1e8 m/s.

title: Special Relativity
description: The speed of light is the same for everyone - so time and space cannot be. Unlocks the Tensor Calculus Engine.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the rest energy of 1 kg of matter, with c in units of 1e8 m/s (answer in 1e16 J).

title: Dyson Swarm
description: Millions of statites harvesting starlight.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the starlight flux (W/m^2) a statite receives at 1 AU (1.496e11 m) from a star of luminosity 3.828e26 W.

title: Protein Folding
description: A chain finds its one shape among astronomically many. Unlocks folded protein crystals.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the time (s) a 30-residue chain would need to try every conformation if each residue has 3 states and each try takes 1e-13 s (Levinthal's paradox).

title: Xenobiology
description: Life in other dimensions does not use DNA. Unlocks xenogenome work, Xenoplasm and silicon life.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how many bits a 100-letter genome stores in an 8-letter (hachimoji-like) genetic alphabet.

title: Neurobiology
description: Grow a brain in a dish and ask it what it thinks. Unlocks neural organoids.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the potassium equilibrium potential (V) of a neuron at 310 K with 5 mM K+ outside and 140 mM inside.
old_puzzle.expr: R * T / F * ln ( co / ci )

title: The Quantum Foam
description: Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how long a virtual particle-antiparticle pair can borrow existence from the vacuum.

title: Causality Violation
description: Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the time interval, in a frame moving at speed v (Lorentz factor γ), between sending and receiving a faster-than-light signal - negative means it arrives before it was sent (units c = 1).

title: Supersymmetry
description: Every boson has a fermion twin. The lightest of them is dark matter.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the relic density of the lightest supersymmetric particle (a WIMP) from its annihilation cross-section.

title: Inside a Black Hole
description: What is past the horizon - and, through an Einstein-Rosen bridge, what is past the white hole's. Unlocks the Horizon Diver and the Geodesic Anchor.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the maximum proper time (s) an infaller can survive between the horizon and the singularity of a 10 solar-mass black hole (M = 1.989e31 kg).

title: The Multiverse
description: Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how many Hubble volumes (pocket universes) eternal inflation creates from one after time t.

title: The Simulation Hypothesis
description: If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the maximum number of bits a simulated region of radius R and energy E can hold (Bekenstein bound) - e.g. a proton.

title: Axiom Theory
description: Beneath the source code of reality lie its axioms - and axioms can be distilled, edited and broken. Unlocks the Axiom Distiller.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Gödel number of the three-symbol formula whose symbol codes are 3, 1 and 2.

title: Theory of Everything
description: Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model as one theory.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the inverse strong coupling at the grand-unification scale Q by running it up from μ = M_Z with the one-loop renormalisation group equation.

title: The Omnilex
description: Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Bekenstein bound - the most bits any region of radius R containing energy E can hold - for a proton; the Omnilex would need this many bits per proton to simulate reality.
